message:
The four folding drop-down wheel arms (C10) stow the chassis inside the start box and then widen the track before driving, leaving a safe spin gap to the frame. Manager, the stowed size is 0.90 by 0.42 by 0.45 m inside the 1.0 by 0.5 by 0.5 m limit with a deployed length of 1.05 m and track of 0.68 m and a 0.025 m rotation gap, per the tip dump clearance check (E51), which is about a door width long and a hand width of clearance.

The rigid grouser wheels stay atop loose simulant and pull far harder than the narrow cut demands. Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead, ground pressure is 15.6 kPa per the ground pressure estimate (E25), like an adult standing on two feet, and traction is 294 N per the tip-over and stopping check (E23) against 11.0 N kerf pull per the kerf cut force scaling (E64), like a grown person's shove against a bag of sugar pull.

The rear pour clears the collection bin lip on level ground without tipping at the half-full trip. Power Structure and Integration Lead, the pivot at 0.55 m clears the 0.40 m lip by 0.150 m with a level-ground tip factor of 1.69 at 15 kg trips, per the tip dump clearance check (E51), about a kerb height of clearance.

Position: ready, because stowed envelope, pressure, traction margin, spin clearance and dump clearance with tip stability all survive with margin and need no redesign.
